title: ClinicalIntakeBrief
description: Structured pre-visit clinical brief produced from a patient phone intake. Sections follow standard clinical chart structure (CC, HPI, ROS).

chief_complaint.description: The single main reason for the visit.

verbatim.description: Patient's own words. NOT a paraphrase. Quote them.

summary.description: Clinician-shorthand summary, e.g. 'RLQ abdominal pain x 2 days'.

hpi.description: History of Present Illness, structured per OPQRST plus associated symptoms and context. Any field may be null if not gathered or not applicable.

onset.description: When and how it started. e.g. '2 days ago, gradual onset' or 'sudden onset this morning'.

duration.description: Total duration if distinct from onset (e.g. 'episodes lasting ~10 minutes each').

aggravating_factors.description: Things that make it worse. e.g. ['eating', 'lying flat'].

alleviating_factors.description: Things that make it better. e.g. ['rest', 'ibuprofen'].

timing.description: Pattern. e.g. 'constant', 'intermittent, worse at night', 'episodic post-prandial'.

associated_symptoms.description: Other symptoms accompanying the CC. e.g. ['nausea', 'low-grade fever'].

context.description: Relevant context — recent injury, new medication, travel, stress, food.

prior_episodes.description: History of similar episodes. 'First time' or description of prior occurrences.

treatments_tried.description: What patient has tried, with response. e.g. ['ibuprofen 400mg, no relief', 'heating pad, mild relief'].

narrative.description: 2-4 sentence clinician-style paragraph in third person summarizing the HPI. This is what the clinician reads first.

ros.description: Targeted Review of Systems. Each system has positives (symptoms present) and negatives (symptoms explicitly denied). Only include systems actually asked about.

red_flags.description: Symptoms or combinations that triggered an emergency-care recommendation during the call.

symptom.description: e.g. 'chest pain radiating to left arm with diaphoresis'

advised_action.description: What the agent told the patient to do.

patient_demographics.description: Demographic info captured during the call. All optional.

patient_identifiers.description: Patient identification + visit context captured in the Phase 0 verification step at the top of the call.

name.description: Patient's name as they stated it. Verbatim where possible.

date_of_birth.description: If captured, ISO date or the patient's phrasing (e.g. 'March 12, 1978').

appointment_time.description: Verbatim — the patient's own phrasing, e.g. 'tomorrow at 2 PM', 'next Tuesday morning'.

appointment_time_iso.description: Resolved ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-04-27T14:00:00'). Computed from `appointment_time` using today's date as the anchor — see system instruction. Null only if the time is genuinely ambiguous (e.g. 'sometime next week').

reason_for_visit_today.description: One-line context for *why today* (e.g. 'symptoms got worse overnight'). Different from the chief complaint.

past_medical_history.description: Named chronic conditions the patient reports (e.g. 'hypertension', 'type 2 diabetes', 'asthma'). Empty if none discussed.

current_medications.description: What the patient is currently taking. Capture name; dose/frequency if offered. Empty if none discussed.

allergies.description: Drug or substance allergies and (if reported) the reaction. Empty if NKDA / none discussed.

social_history.description: Brief social history. Each field optional; only what the patient disclosed.

clinician_notes.description: AI-generated post-hoc considerations. NOT a diagnosis. Hedged. Generated from the transcript at extraction time.

differential_considerations.description: Up to 4 short, hedged differential considerations (e.g. 'consider acute appendicitis vs ovarian pathology'). Each line ≤ 140 chars. Empty if uncertain.

suggested_followups.description: Up to 2 follow-up questions the clinician might want to ask in person.

icd10_candidates.description: 1-3 candidate ICD-10 codes for the chief complaint. AI-generated; clinician reviews before coding.

completeness.description: Computed in code (not by the LLM) from the populated fields. Anything the LLM emits here is ignored.

intake_notes.description: Free-text notes the agent captured at wrap-up — anything the patient wanted the doctor to know that didn't fit elsewhere.

positives.description: Symptoms in this system that the patient confirmed. e.g. ['nausea', 'loose stools x 3'].

negatives.description: Symptoms in this system that the patient explicitly denied. e.g. ['no vomiting', 'no fever'].
